name: taste

description.en: W-TASTE (2026-10-05; report D.1 #6, #7). (1) INTEGER TASTE ON THE DEVICE: the storefront's For-you strip ranks in integers with the server's UNIT=1000, the integer half-life table and a per-mille cosine (store/taste-int.js = crates/dowiz-hub/src/rank.rs), so the phone and the hub rank the same record identically (1000/1000 on the shared fixture crates/dowiz-hub/fixtures/rank/strip.json). The deployed /store/taste-int.js must carry the same half-life table as the hub. (2) taste.dwb: a DG7 columnar block (schema `taste:v1`, hub-only table, not yet in oracle.py/block.bp/bebop-wasm) folded with the menu memo per catalogue generation: per dish the six taste axes 0..5, texture and aroma intensities as two bit planes each, EU14 allergens as a mask (bit 15 = undeclared), on-sale flag, id K64 + bytes; read zero-copy through View; top_k(view, want, avoid, k) is exact, deterministic and byte-equal with the JSON path (top_k_json). It is answered on the Durable Object's internal `GET /fold/menu?block=taste` (Worker <-> DO only); no public route and no server ranking site uses it yet (the server ranks no dishes for a guest today).
description.uk: Телефон ранжує «Для вас» цілими числами, як сервер (1000/1000 рівно); taste.dwb — колонковий блок смаків страв для точного top-k (внутрішній маршрут обʼєкта).

producer.what: project(): products -> taste block; top_k(): exact top-k over View; top_k_json(): the oracle
Memo::block("taste") from the same fold as the JSON

consumer.what: scored()/strip(): the For-you strip in integers

transport.what: the device's integer arithmetic, static asset
taste.dwb bytes; 404 'no such block' when the catalogue does not fit one block

block_layout.format: DG7 DWB1 v1 (crates/dowiz-hub/src/block/mod.rs): 24-byte header, 16-byte column descriptors, 8-aligned columns, crc32 trailer, <= 96 KiB

bits.tex_lo/tex_hi: bit i = level bit 0 / bit 1 of sense::TEXTURE[i] (1..3)

device_asset_schema.description: what the probe extracts from the deployed /store/taste-int.js after importing it

probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-taste.mjs: on qa-durres, (1) /store/taste-int.js is served and, imported, carries the hub's half-life table (equal to crates/dowiz-hub/fixtures/rank/strip.json `half`), fade(2000,60)=1000 and ranks the fixture's first 50 guests as the file says; (2) /store/sense-view.js and /lib/sense-words.js carry the open-meteo credit in four languages; (3) Suggest on qa-water validates against feature-sense 1.1.0 (ai provenance, source lexicon or lexicon+model) and writes nothing. The DO-internal ?block=taste is NOT reachable from outside: proven in-memory only (fold/menu tests).
